detailed_descriptions.en: Slowly Sliding Ducks is the multiplayer sibling of Placid Plastic Duck Simulator! Relax with friends in a social pool where you can customize your duck, then jump into an online party game for 8–16 players whenever you feel like it. Compete against friends, foes, or bots in a delightfully absurd variety of minigames: race to the finish line, be the last duck standing, or try to come in last in a race where you simply sit back and watch (just like a marble race). And once the competition is over, unlock new outfits and show off your latest acquisitions in the 50-player community pool! Mess With Your Friends Or Team Up Against Randoms Or Score More Than Anyone! And Show Off Your Style TURBOLENTO NOTES Slowly Sliding Ducks contains in-game items that can be purchased with real money. About this, we want to make things clear: All cosmetics can be unlocked through gameplay. No item is exclusively obtainable through monetary purchase. Microtransactions are strictly cosmetic and do not provide any gameplay advantage. Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Slowly Sliding Ducks is the multiplayer sibling of Placid Plastic Duck Simulator!

Relax with friends in a social pool where you can customize your duck, then jump into an online party game for 8–16 players whenever you feel like it.

Compete against friends, foes, or bots in a delightfully absurd variety of minigames: race to the finish line, be the last duck standing, or try to come in last in a race where you simply sit back and watch (just like a marble race).

And once the competition is over, unlock new outfits and show off your latest acquisitions in the 50-player community pool!

Mess With Your Friends

Or Team Up Against Randoms

Or Score More Than Anyone!

And Show Off Your Style

TURBOLENTO NOTES

Slowly Sliding Ducks contains in-game items that can be purchased with real money. About this, we want to make things clear:

  • All cosmetics can be unlocked through gameplay. No item is exclusively obtainable through monetary purchase.

  • Microtransactions are strictly cosmetic and do not provide any gameplay advantage.

Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases.

We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative.
